## What do you want to do

Describe the problem first, then the change you have in mind.

## How does this serve the goal

Wickey keeps real provider keys out of reach of the apps and agents that use them, with
short-lived local proxy keys and a passphrase to mint them. How does your idea serve that?

## Does it keep the principles

- [ ] Local-first: nothing leaves the machine except proxied requests to the provider
- [ ] Zero runtime dependencies (Node 24 built-ins only). If not, why is it needed?
- [ ] Works on macOS, Linux and Windows
- [ ] Honest security: it does not claim protection the code cannot give. Does it add a new limit to document?
- [ ] If it mints a key or can redirect a real key, it goes through the passphrase gate
